# New Account Contact

`customer_support.sit.new_account_contact` · v1.0.0 · **draft**

Owned by `customer_support.support_management.account_relationship_management`


> A new person has appeared on a supported account — introduced, handed over to, or simply copied in as the successor to someone who has gone. They arrive with the account's entire support history in our records and none of it in their head, and with no idea what the account is actually entitled to. The correct move is not a welcome message. It is a short, concrete orientation: what you are entitled to and through which channel, what is currently open, what has already been resolved that you may be about to re-report, and who to contact when it is urgent. This costs one message and prevents the first-contact failure that otherwise defines the relationship for a year. It is also, quietly, our own housekeeping — our records still name the person who left, and the ticket that gets routed to them is the one nobody answers.

owner **Customer Support** · updated 2026-08-08 · review **unreviewed** · confidence **provisional**


> introduction and followup_sent are real substrate observation kinds. entitlement_checked, ticket_created, escalation_requested and angry_language are support-native and sit in planned_substrate.obs_kinds. Unvalidated lists, legal mixture, recorded here so it is not mistaken for coverage.
ticket_created is listed under progress and that is arguable — a new contact filing their first ticket is normal volume, not a win. It is here because the failure mode this situation guards against is a successor who never contacts us at all and quietly stops treating support as available, which is indistinguishable from a healthy handover until the renewal. First contact is the cheapest available evidence that the handover took.
champion_change under decay means a SECOND handover shortly after this one: the account is churning internally, our records are now two people stale, and no orientation we send will survive long enough to matter. That is a different and worse situation than this one and the domain does not yet have a file for it.
